svg.text: Models interpret the task and audit evidence.
The kernel enforces the rules: no refutation below decisive strength, no absence as proof, no delivered artifact as its own authority, no record evidence for a world claim.
The final verdict is compiled from the task statement and checked against the delivered world. The agent’s own report of success never counts as evidence.
Offline: score a captured run. Interactive: an MCP server verifies each claim as the agent commits it.
